verdict: The CCM client cache does not have enough free space for the requested content.
fix: Raise the CCM cache size via client settings (`Compliance Settings / Client Cache Settings`) so it is larger than the biggest single-package content delivered to this collection. Alternately clear stale cache: `Invoke-CimMethod -Namespace root\ccm\softmgmtagent -ClassName CacheInfoEx -MethodName DeleteCacheInfoEx -Arguments @{ CacheContentID = '<contentID>' }` or use the `Cache` tab on the Configuration Manager control panel applet.
